source_of_truth: This fixture is the contract for H0-A02 through H0-A06. Implementation may lag, but a deviation must be recorded as a change request.

global_shell.label: Global navigation

items.label: Projects
items.implementation_note: Target subview; current baseline exposes project list through Dashboard.

rules: The same four items and order appear on all project workspace routes.
Global navigation never contains a project-specific finding, model, control, test, evidence, or report link.
Current project identity is shown in the project header, not represented as a second global menu variant.

project_workflow.label: Overview
project_workflow.goal: Understand run status and the next action.

project_workflow.label: DFD model
project_workflow.goal: Review canonical nodes, flows, zones, boundaries, and evidence.

project_workflow.label: Findings
project_workflow.goal: Triage STRIDE/LINDDUN scenarios grounded in DFD interactions.

project_workflow.label: Action plan
project_workflow.goal: Decide control applicability and prepare verification tests.

project_workflow.label: Evidence
project_workflow.goal: Resolve, assign, or defer evidence gaps and assumptions.

project_workflow.label: Report & sign-off
project_workflow.goal: Review immutable provenance and sign-off readiness.

navigation_rules: The workflow appears in the same position and order on all six project routes.
Desktop uses an inline step navigation; mobile uses one current-stage picker/drawer.
Active stage has aria-current='step' or equivalent selected state; unavailable stages remain navigable but expose readiness/blocker state.
Page-local navigation such as Report section TOC is subordinate to the project workflow and never replaces it.
Contextual topbar actions are allowed only when they are not a duplicate of a visible workflow destination.

transition_rules: Workspace links preserve id and run; a stage link changes phase and clears incompatible view/selection.
Finding/control/test/evidence deep links preserve exact selected canonical ID.
Invalid enum/filter values are ignored individually; valid state is not discarded.
Reload, Back, Forward, and direct deep link reproduce the same project/run/stage/selection state.
Report revision is read-only context and must never mutate the canonical current draft.

analysis.goal: Understand analysis lifecycle status and next action.
analysis.status: Run state + current phase + preserved-result/deferred state

model.goal: Review the canonical DFD and boundary decisions.

action-plan.goal: Resolve control applicability and verification readiness.

evidence.goal: Resolve or explicitly defer evidence gaps.

report.goal: Review an immutable, reproducible report revision.

state_copy.not_scored: Not scored — context or evidence is missing

rules: Use English consistently for the default locale; do not mix Belum tahu with English UI labels.
Deferred, unknown, and not scored must never be presented as safe/no risk.
Use one verb for one action; do not alternate View/Open/Edit/Update when the consequence is the same.
Technical jargon gets a plain-language helper on first exposure and remains precise in inspector/export.

global: No horizontal overflow at 320, 390, 768, 1280, or 1440 CSS px.
Overlay open/close owns Escape, focus return, scroll lock, and selected object preservation.
Sticky/fixed UI never covers a focused element or the primary task surface.
Page goal, status, and primary action remain discoverable in the first viewport.
model: Canvas is first-class and occupies at least 55% of desktop viewport height.
Mobile boundary review defaults closed; the target sheet is opened by an explicit trigger.
Fit preserves selected element visibility and produces no node/label overlap that blocks interpretation.

navigation_variants.baseline: at least 3 shell variants across six routes

workflow_visibility.target: six of six routes expose current stage

primary_cta.target: exactly one primary CTA per route/state

state_preservation.target: id/run/phase/view/selection/filter preserved through direct link and Back/Forward

readability.target: essential text at least 12px; body/task copy 14–16px

expert_trace.target: DFD → finding → control → test in 60 seconds

novice_orientation.target: status + next action understood in 10 seconds

change_control.approval: Product + UX + FE lead before markup/CSS contract changes; QA review before release-gate changes.
change_control.compatibility: Canonical DFD/threat/control/test IDs and deferred semantics cannot be changed by a UI-only contract request.
